claims.summary: The 100-case A/B workbook reconstructs from the exact v0.16.40 source packet, uses ten immutable chunks, and binds GPT-5.6-Luna/max on Codex CLI 0.144.2 before judgment.
One fresh ephemeral clean-room session completed all 100 A/B cases under one pinned identity without organizer, reverse-order, prior-outcome, repository-rule, or user-config inputs.

A fail-closed completion gate rejected an unsupported label; a bounded transform changed exactly 200 complete-to-scored statuses only after proving five valid numeric scores and changed no judgment content.
The canonical 100-case pass was encrypted directly into one validated AES-256-GCM envelope without combined plaintext, and two untracked 0600 keys passed authenticated in-memory round trips.
A/B remains outcome-sealed and B/A remains missing, so stable preferences, training rows, quality-adapter weights, held-out wins, and paid-reference parity remain zero or unclaimed.
